title: The KGB gives the Tsar's box seat to Malmgren instead of Kissinger

tellings.quote: Zar and one of the KB people said, "Henry, not tonight. Not tonight. That seat is for Dr. Mal.

plain: In Moscow in 1982, officers of the KGB, the Soviet secret police, are said to have stopped Henry Kissinger, the former US Secretary of State, from taking the seat in the old royal box of the Tsar, telling him, "Henry, not tonight. That seat is for Dr. Malmgren." Harold Malmgren, an economist who advised American presidents, tells this himself as the man the seat was kept for, to show how much weight the Soviets gave him.
